faqs: Can I start for free?

Yes. Free includes scans of up to 25 products and basic reporting. Standard and Pro have a 14-day free trial, with monthly or annual billing. Shopify displays the terms before you approve a subscription.
What happens if order access is unavailable?
StockClearance uses available inventory age and stock-level signals. Sales velocity and sales-based results depend on the order history Shopify makes available to the app.
Will the app change my prices?
Clearance actions can change prices or create discounts and collections. Review the proposed action and your settings; Pro rules can automate the clearance decisions you configure.
What data does StockClearance use?

Product and inventory records, prices, available unit costs, discount and action records, and order-line signals support the inventory workflow. See the StockClearance section of our privacy policy for collection, measurement, and deletion details.
How do I cancel?
Manage the subscription through Shopify. Uninstalling the app triggers account-data cleanup. Charges already incurred and any refunds are governed by the subscription terms shown by Shopify.

faqs: What are the current billing options?

The Shopify listing offers Free, Standard at $19 per month, and Pro at $190 per year. The annual option is listed as Pro. Review the features and subscription terms on Shopify before approving a plan.
Does TariffShield offer a paid-plan trial?
The current listing offers a free plan for 10 SKUs and does not advertise a paid-plan free trial.
Will my prices change automatically?
TariffShield applies individual or bulk price updates when you approve them. Review your costs and margin targets before applying an update.
Are these final customs charges?

Tariff and margin results support planning. Actual treatment depends on classification, origin, destination, eligibility, and the applicable rules. Verify shipment-specific charges before relying on an estimate.
How does Exact Duty differ from margin analysis?

Exact Duty is a read-only workflow for supported U.S. scenarios using the exact HTSUS number, origin, MFN rate, Chapter 99 facts, customs value, and entry time you supply. It does not classify goods or infer program eligibility; unsupported or incomplete cases return no duty number. Multi-market margin analysis is a separate planning feature.
What data does TariffShield use?

The app uses product, variant, inventory, price, available cost, origin, classification, and configuration data, along with saved analysis and price-action records. See the TariffShield section of our privacy policy.

faqs: Is there a free plan and a trial?
Free supports up to 25 batches or lots. Standard and Pro each offer a 14-day free trial, with monthly and annual billing options. Shopify shows the terms before you approve a subscription.
Does ShelfLife automatically maintain batch quantities?
Merchants maintain quantities in ShelfLife. Update batch records as inventory moves or is sold so expiry reports and picking guidance reflect your records.
What does FEFO do?
First-expired, first-out guidance helps you identify which batches to pick first by expiry date and location. It is available on Pro.
Will it send emails as soon as I install?
ShelfLife expiry alerts and weekly digests are opt-in features on Standard and Pro. Configure an alert address and enable the notifications you want.
Can I use ShelfLife during a recall?
Batch, supplier, and traceability records can help you investigate affected stock. Their usefulness depends on the records you maintain; you remain responsible for recall decisions and execution.
What happens to my data when I uninstall?

Uninstall starts cleanup of your batch, settings, alert, session, and measurement records. Limited protected identifiers can remain to prevent delayed work from recreating erased data. Use available cleanup controls for Shopify-hosted copies while the app is still installed; after uninstall it no longer has Shopify Admin access. Our privacy policy explains these boundaries.
